text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series—
A stage where Umamusume kindle their passion
and run toward their dreams.

“And supporting and guiding them
is the Trainer's role.”
That is why a Trainer must constantly accumulate knowledge and experience, running alongside their Umamusume day after day.

text_block_list.name: Simulator Voice
text_block_list.text: "Happy Meek has set a new record—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Good work, Bitter Glasse. Are you feeling any VR motion sickness?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Peace.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, wonderful.
Thanks to that, I've gathered new data.
With this, you should be able to handle your current regimen!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: —Ah, Trainer <username>!

The one who noticed me and called out was
my fellow classmate, Trainer Aoi Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I was just using the "VR Umalator"
to analyze Meek's running form.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: After all, we're rookie Trainers, so we've got to make use of whatever resources we can!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>,
let's both do our best
for the sake of the Umamusume we train!

"The clear, sunny skies seem to herald
the grand opening of our journey into the Twinkle Series—"

"It was as though the clear, boundless sky
was welcoming our challenge."
"Assemble!"

After school, a paging announcement echoed through the academy,
summoning all the trainers to the gymnasium.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Quiet, everyone! You all provide daily support
and guidance for the success of our Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes turning the pages of textbooks, sometimes sifting through data,
she made allies of various resources to guide the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Attention! Today,
a new ally joins the ranks of our instructors!"

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To all our Trainers, from here on, the explanation will be given by
myself, Satono Diamond, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Satono Crown will handle it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The Satono Group's software development division has always stayed ahead of the curve—so much so that people say we're almost too far ahead of our time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And bringing together our cutting-edge technology, we have created the Training Support AI System—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Its name is the "Mega Dream Supporter"!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: "Does that mean there are new things we'll be able to do in the VR Umalator?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When taking charge of an Umamusume,
have you ever found yourself hesitating over anything?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For example, whether it's okay to push harder in pre-race training,
or whether she can still compete if the distance is slightly outside her aptitude—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"For times like that, I have just completed
an AI system to support your decision-making!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: We gather and analyze all kinds of data recorded since the very beginning of Umamusume racing—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The ultimate AI that derives the best answer from countless cases and statistics!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it will prove to be a most reassuring ally
for all of our Trainers!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing is believing. Let's go over the details
while actually trying out the software♪"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: An AI that derives the optimal answer...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: There doesn't seem to be any harm in looking into it for the sake of raising Umamusume.

Without even needing to think, the answer came immediately.
For me, as a rookie Trainer, to chase dreams together with my Umamusume—
And so, seeking advantages for Umamusume training, I plunged into the world of VR.

Welcome to the Mega Dream
Supporter...Get Ready!

Projected right before my eyes was
Tracen Academy, recreated in VR space.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Welcome, so glad you could make it♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Recreating buildings and courses might not be
that surprising to you since you've probably experienced it
in other VR software, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"There's something amazing in this software!
Come on, I'll show you around!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: As I explained, this software contains a vast amount of data—packed with information on Umamusume from the past to the present.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"The AI that processes them needs to be given a thought process for how to interpret the data—
in other words, a personality—but..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: After an AI programmed with the mindsets of 'Bravery,' 'Discipline,' and 'Affection' underwent repeated deep learning—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Something really interesting just happened!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Each of the three AIs developed a personality—no,
you could say they were born with souls!

Just then, the room was enveloped in a dazzling light.
Before long, appearing right before our eyes was—

The sun rises, and countless stars begin to shine.
Yet no two stars possess the exact same light.

Let us wrap the children drifting in the vast sea
in gentle waves, and protect them.

An unyielding earth that upholds all things.
Become one of the strong, and tread upon it firmly enough to leave your mark.

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"I am Darley Arabian.
Every Umamusume is unique, and everyone is a protagonist.
Let's nurture and polish each and every one of them!"

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"My name is Godolphin Barb.
Allow me to watch over the hoofprints left by Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
My name is Byerley Turk.
To carve your own path, you have no choice but to become strong.
If you have begun to run, steel your resolve.
choice_data_list: T-That name is... could it be...!?

text_block_list.text:
Standing there were three Umamusume she had never seen before—
yet whose names she somehow knew.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Did you notice the names of these people?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume who ran for so long, and who is said to be our ancestor!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right! The three AIs have begun
calling themselves by the names of the Three Goddesses!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stiff, little lamb!
Goddesses though we may be, we're support AIs.
In short, we're your friendly neighbors.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
Holding back is not merely unnecessary, it is foolish.
Consult with us proactively and dedicate yourself to training Umamusume.
We will spare no knowledge in guiding you.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, rely on us as much as you like.
The woven history of Umamusume—the Wisdom of the Goddesses—will always be here to support you.

"A training support AI introduced
as a powerful ally to Umamusume and Trainers."
"With the 'Three Goddesses' who oversee vast amounts of data by your side, a thrilling three-year racing journey begins!"
